positions.title: Graduate Research
positions.description:
- Implementing a secure, decentralized, end-to-end verifiable voting system; built atop blockchain technology, Ethereum.
- Solidity contracts offer self-tallying, validating, and authentication mechanisms.

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description:
- Developed password manager — Chrome extension.
- Runner-ups in the Startup Battlefield of Disrupt SF 2016.
- Responsible for architecture, tooling, and design decisions regarding product implementation and flow.

positions.title: Co-op Software Developer - IBM jStart
positions.description:
- Developed a big data analytics system to track users over wireless mesh networks.
- Built a machine learned model for real-time indoor positioning system using Apache Spark.
- Prototyped a distributed hash table simulator on IBM’s Bluemix PaaS with Node.js and D3.js.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Research beehive data acquisition techniques using embedded systems with emphasis on real-time computing constraints. Research involves acquiring and transmitting data such as temperature, humidity, audio, and video to servers for analysis.

positions.title: Co-Founder & Developer
positions.description:
- Developed a crowdsourced taxi-like service to match designated drivers with local students in need of a ride.
- Arbitrated over 15,000 rides in our first year running.

honors.title: VTHacks 3rd Place - Coincraft
honors.description: Our hackathon project was a competitive Minecraft mod where users "mine for bitcoin" by racing to find a single hidden diamond ore within a Minecraft map. The first user to find the diamond ore wins, and earns a pool of bitcoin.
